_comment: Starter voice library: a stage's motion fills its {voice...} slots from one of these (pipeline/voice_registry.py). Your own goes in data/library/voices.json.

soft.label: Soft
soft.voice: a soft, warm young adult woman's voice

low.label: Low
low.voice: a low, calm adult man's voice
low.delivery: says (S) in a low, calm tone

whisper.label: Whisper
whisper.voice: a young adult woman speaking only in a soft whisper
